purpose: W with ON under .tran uic, control inside a positive band (it=0.5m, ih=0.2m): ngspice starts it on and keeps it on. The UIC load seeds HYST_ON from CSWzero_stateGiven into state0 whatever the unsolved control (cswload.c:39-56), dctran.c:387-392 copies state0 to state1 at MODEINITTRAN, and every later in-band iteration takes state1 (cswload.c:65-71, written back at :130). OFF and no word start off (REALLY_OFF from the 0 A control at the UIC load). S with ON starts off: swload.c reads state0, which INITTRAN rewrites from the unsolved 0 V control (:99-108). ESPice cannot tell a uic start from the transient's .op (both evaluate with kind .ic and initial_step, sim_init.zig and op.zig), so cswitch.va starts every W off in the band: v(owon) = 0.999 V where ngspice gives 0.999 mV. Samples skip t = 0: ngspice's uic run writes no t = 0 row.

oracle.derivation: Stock ngspice-44.2 batch run of this deck, binary raw, columns by name; stock ngspice-45 writes the same bytes. Every column is constant over the run (no switch changes state), so the samples at 1-4 us are its one value. Analytic check: on = 1/1001 V (ron=1 under 1k), off = 1meg/1.001meg V; ngspice is within 1 ulp of both. On and off differ 1000x.
